persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śṛīśrī jaya bhūpatīndra malladevasana yāṅā juro

notes: The colophon commemorates the rathapratiṣṭhā of Mahābhairava performed by King Bhūpatīndra Malla on this date. Place of copying is identified as Bhaktapur in catalogue metadata based on the king, but is not written in the colophon text itself.
